the past I've made that claim and people have been surprised by it. It doesn't seem to be common knowledge. If you didn't know it or you doubt it, then I'd recommend you check out an engineering talk by Andrej Karpathy. This isn't a Tesla marketing piece. It was a workshop talk at the Computer Vision and Pattern Matching conference in 2021. Andrej Karpathy is the senior director of AI at Tesla. He was someone involved in this decision to switch from radar to vision only and in the talk he outlines the engineering reasons which motivate the switch.
